stories.title: Shared MacSTTCore library; CLI unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: Audio, Engines, Protocols, Output code lives in target MacSTTCore; mac-stt CLI depends on it (spec AC5)
`make build` succeeds with zero warnings and `.build/release/mac-stt --help` and `--list-locales` still work
`swift test` passes, including the existing 35 tests

stories.title: Script recorder + mic device identifier
acceptanceCriteria: ScriptRecorder appends '[HH:mm:ss] text' per finalized sentence, flushed per write, new file per session (spec AC9, AC10)
MicrophoneCapture accepts an optional device UID; unknown UID yields a clear error (spec AC14)
Unit tests cover recorder format/append/new-file-per-session and UID lookup

stories.title: Overlay window and UI
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom subtitle bar shows latest 1-2 large lines, floats above windows, does not take focus (AC1)
Transcript panel mode scrolls through finalized sentences with selectable text; modes switch without stopping recognition (AC2, AC3)
Window position/size per mode persist across launches (AC4)
Design produced with the frontend-design skill

stories.title: Menu-bar controls and session control
acceptanceCriteria: Menu: Start/Stop, language (en-US, en-AU, ko-KR), source (mic/system), display mode, script folder actions, Quit (AC7)
Changing language while running restarts recognition and menu shows the active language (AC8)
Mic is the default source; system audio selectable (AC6)
Permission denial shows an actionable message in the overlay and menu (AC11)

stories.title: App bundle, signing, notarization scripts
acceptanceCriteria: `make app` produces a runnable .app (LSUIElement, usage strings, entitlements, hardened runtime, ad-hoc signed) (AC11,12 local part)
`make app-release` performs Developer ID signing, notarytool submit, staple, spctl check, driven by env vars; NOT executed without user credentials (AC12 reported unverified)

stories.title: End-to-end verification and review
acceptanceCriteria: App launched with system source plays `say` audio and writes a timestamped script file; first partial about 2s or less (AC13 via same method)
Unmeasured items (far-field accuracy AC15 field test, Voice Isolation in bundle, notarization) reported honestly
Reviewer approval against all criteria; deslop pass; post-deslop build+tests green

stories.title: Core: offline translation pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: MacSTTCore exposes TextTranslator, TranslationPipeline (single-flight, latest-partial-wins, finals never dropped and ordered, stale partial results discarded after a final) and a system translator using Apple's Translation framework only
Unit tests with a fake translator cover latest-wins, ordered finals, stale discard, error surfacing
Availability check reports clear reasons (OS < 26.4, pair unsupported, models not installed)
lowLatency strategy is tried first and falls back to highFidelity when its model is not installed

stories.title: App: translation settings, display and recording
acceptanceCriteria: Menu: Translation submenu (Off / Korean / English, layout: original+translation or translation only), persisted, changeable while listening without restarting recognition
Subtitle bar shows translation as primary text with a small original line above; interim translation muted, final translation full contrast; bar height accounts for the extra row
Transcript panel rows show original and translation; transcript file gets '[HH:mm:ss] → translation' lines paired by timestamp
Unavailable translation shows an actionable notice instead of failing silently
Verified end-to-end offline (network denied) with say audio: translated partial appears before the sentence is final; final translation replaces it

stories.title: Verification, review, regression
acceptanceCriteria: make build/app warning-free, swift test passes, reviewer approval, deslop, post-deslop regression

stories.title: Benchmark harness and baseline
acceptanceCriteria: FileAudioCapture streams an audio file in real time (plus trailing silence) through the real engines; unit-tested
TextMetrics computes WER (words) and CER (characters) with normalization; unit-tested
stt-bench reports startup time, first-partial latency, final delay, WER/CER, translation lag, CPU%, peak RSS for en-US, en-AU, ko-KR
`make bench` produces Benchmarks/results/<label>.md; baseline results committed and tagged

stories.title: UX/UI review, settings window, Korean UI, first-run setup
acceptanceCriteria: docs/UX-REVIEW.md lists findings from the original UX with a decision for each
Settings window (General, Display, Translation, Vocabulary, Transcripts) replaces menu nesting; menu keeps essentials
UI strings localized Korean/English following the system language, switchable in Settings
First-run/permission screen shows live status of microphone, speech recognition and screen/system-audio permission with buttons that open the right System Settings pane

stories.title: Overlay usability
acceptanceCriteria: Overlay can fade after N seconds of silence and reappears on speech
Click-through option so the overlay never blocks the meeting UI
Global hotkeys: start/stop captions and cycle display mode, configurable on/off

stories.title: Feature A: two-way conversation mode
acceptanceCriteria: A Korean user can leave captions on while both sides speak: English speech is shown with Korean translation, Korean speech with English translation, language chosen automatically per utterance
Detection accuracy and added latency measured with the benchmark on mixed en/ko audio and reported honestly
Falls back to a manual language toggle when auto-detection is unavailable

stories.title: Feature B: meeting vocabulary
acceptanceCriteria: Vocabulary editor in Settings (names, product terms); persisted; applied to both engines as contextual strings
Benchmark shows the effect on a term-heavy sample (reported honestly, including no effect)

stories.title: Re-benchmark, verify, release
acceptanceCriteria: make build/app warning-free, swift test passes, `make bench` run again and compared with the baseline in docs
Reviewer approval, deslop, post-deslop regression, commit and tag v0.2.0

stories.title: Rename the product to Ieum
acceptanceCriteria: No remaining user-visible or build-visible use of 'STT Overlay', 'STTOverlay', 'MacSTT', 'mac-stt', 'stt-bench' outside historical records (.omc, tags, commit history)
Targets/dirs renamed: IeumCore, ieum-cli (IeumCLI), Ieum (app), IeumBench (ieum-bench), IeumTests; app bundle Ieum.app with id dev.local.ieum
make build, make app, swift test (all tests), make bench harness build all pass warning-free; the app launches, shows Ieum in menu/windows, and conversation mode still works end to end

stories.title: GitHub repository and push

git remote and remote refs verified (main, v0.1.0, bench-baseline-v0.1.0, v0.2.0, rename tag)

stories.title: First-run self test so new users see it work before a meeting
acceptanceCriteria: Setup window has a Try it card that plays a sentence and shows recognized text and translation
Saved mode and source are restored; no transcript file is created
Failure messages cover volume, headphones and a closed MacBook lid
Released, site FAQ and download updated
stories.notes: v0.2.7. Verified end to end with system audio (lid closed during verification); mic path verified earlier with lid open.

stories.title: Let the user choose whether the captions stay above all windows
acceptanceCriteria: Setting, menu bar menu and overlay menu toggle keep-on-top (default on)
Off: the captions are a normal window that other windows can cover (z-order verified)
Off: the show/hide shortcut brings a covered overlay to the front instead of hiding it (verified with a Finder window)
Docs updated
stories.notes: Verified with window ordering via CGWindowList: layer 3 when on top, layer 0 and coverable when off; bring-to-front and the covered check verified.

stories.title: Animated What's new tour after an update
acceptanceCriteria: Shown once after an update with only the pages newer than the last seen version; never on first install, same version or downgrade (unit tested)
Five scenes with looping animation, back/next/skip, dots, keyboard, reduced motion respected
Reopenable from Settings > About
Docs updated
stories.notes: Pages and layout verified by window screenshots; Esc/Return/click could not be driven from the agent shell because the app is not activated there.

stories.title: Fix English panel header wrap and the menu closing during recognition; show deployed version
acceptanceCriteria: Panel header on one line in English for every mode
Overlay menu stays open while sentences are recognized (verified with system audio)
Site shows the latest release version and size

stories.title: Offer and install updates from inside the app
acceptanceCriteria: Once-a-day opt-out check of a small feed; asks before installing
Install verifies SHA-256, Team ID, codesign and notarization before replacing; a wrong checksum is refused
End to end: a copy of the app was replaced by the notarized 0.2.9 DMG and relaunched (about 5 s)
Privacy copy (site, README, guide, PRD) says the update check is the only request and can be turned off
Release script writes the feed
stories.notes: Code at 0.3.0, not released yet. Verified against a local feed with -updateFeedURL/-updateCurrentVersion.
